youtube.title: Don't Know What To Do? Morning Prayer Today | James 1:5 KJV
youtube.text:
Good morning. Don't know what to do about something? Ask.

"If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him." James 1:5 (KJV)

He doesn't make you feel dumb for asking. He just gives.

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.
